items.prompt: A good feature branch name often looks like…
items.explain: Use a typed prefix plus a short kebab-case slug: feature/alu-mul.

choices: Creates the branch and switches to it
items.explain: checkout -b creates a new branch at the current commit and moves HEAD there.

items.prompt: Work committed on a feature branch stays off main until you merge or cherry-pick it.
items.explain: Branches isolate commits; main only gains them after integration.

items.prompt: Before creating a branch for shared coursework, you should…
choices: Branch from any random local tip without fetching
Update main from the remote, then branch from that tip
items.explain: Fetch/pull so main is current, then branch from that updated tip.
